info.description: The headings on /publications/, and the MYRA STEM Lab newsletter pages. ⚠ THE PUBLICATIONS THEMSELVES ARE NOT HERE — each newsletter, magazine and e-paper is a row in the Publications collection, because the school adds to that list regularly and a 33-entry nested list is not something anyone should have to scroll. This holds only what wraps them. ⚠ THE BANNER, PAGE TITLE AND SEO ARE ON PAGE META for /publications/, which is where every page on the site keeps them, banner upload included.
